technical-summary: LTX03: the issued tensor-parallel lane now chains the modulated norm, the FFN and the gated residual, and runs self-attention plus FFN as one block, compared with a TP1 issue on the host and on the three cards (reductions counted per rank). A warm-step timing mode measures one card, three cards at several head splits, and two cards. The rad0060 declare guards take the tensor-parallel world size from the geometry (at least two) instead of a fixed three. Measured at 2048 tokens the exact reductions dominate: TP3 is slower than one card, and two cards roughly break even on the FFN.
user-summary-candidate: LTX tensor-parallel test lane now covers a full attention and feed-forward block and measures its speed.
